scope: read-only input characterization: SEARCH-v3 main128/stress32 and canonical Open15

definitions.final_to_bound: F / (20*ceil(P/20)); P is historical peak live volume
definitions.deletion_age_rank: 0=oldest live PID; 1=newest; fractions exclude deletions with one live pipe
definitions.completed_lifetime: deletion operation index minus insertion operation index, divided by trace operations
definitions.censoring: survivors are right-censored; completed-lifetime metrics describe deleted pipes only
definitions.early_survivors: pipes allocated in first 10% of operation indices and still alive at the end
definitions.age_size_correlation: Pearson on completed lifetimes only, not an unbiased full-lifetime estimate
definitions.size_histogram_tv: 0.5*sum(abs(p_size-q_size)); only marginal-size similarity, not trace equivalence
definitions.range_coverage: one-dimensional empirical min/max; membership does not establish joint or mechanism coverage
definitions.summaries: per-trace statistics; Open15 also has official-weight means; no hypothesis-test p values
definitions.windows: 20 operation-time bins; curves sampled at 101 positions in normalized operation time
